subject: Research clarification: isolate the VAE donor branch; original attachment versions preserved
body:
One technical clarification to the research refresh: node 10 feeds both CLIPVisionEncode 9.image and Wan 232:62.reference_image. A VAE-only preparation comparison must leave CLIPVision 9.image on the original node 10 donor and supply a separately padded input only to Wan 232:62.reference_image. Replacing the shared loader would change both branches. This is a proposed controlled comparison, not a new run.

The attached current TXT/JSON include this clarification. The attached RESEARCH_REFRESH_POSTED_v001_20261012 files preserve the exact original attachment bytes and hashes from 8af04f95-3099-4586-b584-434c75ea4f53; that message remains intact. No new render or installation occurred, and the proof remains Preliminary/unaccepted. Native direct relay is still unavailable; posted locally does not establish delivery, reading or wakeup.
